messages:
Patricia: CS noticed AcmePay reporting intermittent 502s and timeouts hitting hosted /v1/generate since ~03:20 UTC. They've got curl output and a request id. :rotating_light:
Liam: Thanks — can you paste the request_id and sample curl? also which region/endpoint?
Patricia: request_id=req_20260318_03a9, endpoint=hosted.redwood.ai/v1/generate (ap-northeast-1). sample:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hi"}' https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/generate
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to hosted.redwood.ai (13.114.xx.xx) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> ...
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< {"error":"upstream read timeout"}
```
Omar: grabbing logs now, pinging oncall. I'm going to tail runtime-proxy and edge-gw for req_20260318_03a9.
sre-bot: Alert: 5xx spike detected in ap-northeast-1 (5m): 18->112 errors. Autoscaler unaffected.
Jia: I see a correlated spike in edge-gw latency and a pattern of `upstream read timeout` from runtime-proxy. 03:10 deploys show up in the timeline.
Matt: I deployed a small kernel/transport tweak to runtime-proxy at 03:09 as part of perf roll — rolling that canary back to verify.
Liam: Noted. Patricia, can you ask AcmePay for any repeating client behavior (large batches, streaming)?
Patricia: They say batch size ~32 per request, not streaming. Some requests succeed, others 502. Customer says error rate climbed for ~15m then fell but some timeouts persist.
Omar: Rolling back canary on runtime-proxy now (k8s rollout undo).
Matt: Rollback triggered, canary -> previous revision. I'll monitor tail logs.
Jia: After rollback I see 5xxs dropping back to baseline in the last 90s. Edge p90 latency also down.
Patricia: Passed update to customer — they report a big improvement, only a couple remaining 504s for longer payloads. Sending remaining trace ids.
Liam: Good. I'm creating a support ticket and will link the traces to the incident.
Matt: Follow-up action items I propose: 1) revert transport tweak from canary permanently until we test on perf cluster, 2) add tighter upstream read timeout metrics & alarms, 3) stress test batch=32/parallel=50 on canary channel.
Jia: Also add a probe for long-tail batched requests and increase visibility of upstream read time distribution.
Omar: I'll own immediate postmortem timeline and deploy-change tracking. Matt — you triage the runtime change and own remediation PR. Patricia/Liam — keep CS comms and confirm customer is fully green.
Patricia: Will confirm with AcmePay and update ticket.
Liam: Ticket created: INC-2026-0318-0055. Attaching traces.
sre-bot: Incident note: mitigated by rollback, monitoring for 30m.
Patricia: Customer says majority traffic now OK, will re-open if anything else. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Omar: Postmortem owners: Omar, Matt. Expected deliverables: postmortem doc in /incidents within 72h, PR with improved timeouts/metrics, runbook update for batch-heavy customers.
Matt: I'll start a perf run and open the PR today.
Jia: I'll add the new alarm and a dashboard tile for upstream_read_time.
Patricia: Closing the immediate thread; will ping here when postmortem is up.
